description: Re-screen label smoothing at population level under Muon. Base: E116 code. Change only the label-smoothing constant from 0.3 to 0.2, a loss constant inside the compiled train graph. Re-warm the graphs in build if the constant is baked in, and verify no recompiles on a dev run. Nothing else changes. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled E116 baseline. Add one scored run. E037 (LS 0.2, 3 seeds, SE ~0.2 pp) could not exclude ±0.3 pp; tuned Muon CIFAR recipes use LS ~0.09.
